# Orientation works from an unrelated directory and requires no ticket.
mkdir caller
cd caller
exec ctx orient --bundle ../empty
! stderr .
stdout 'Project: Empty project \[empty-project\]'
stdout 'Evaluation: complete; inventory: complete'
stdout 'Goals:'
stdout 'No current delivery goals\.'
stdout 'Current commitments: none'
stdout 'Shortlist: none'
stdout 'Sources:'
cmp ../empty/project.md ../original.md

# The machine-readable form contains one versioned report with array fields.
exec ctx orient --bundle ../empty --json
! stderr .
cp stdout orientation.json
jsonorientation orientation.json true
stdout '"schemaVersion":1'
stdout '"complete":true'
stdout '"inventoryComplete":true'
stdout '"workItems":\[\]'
stdout '"shortlist":\[\]'
stdout '"inProgress":\[\]'
stdout '"backlog":\[\]'
stdout '"decisions":\[\]'
stdout '"diagnostics":\[\]'
cmp ../empty/project.md ../original.md

-- empty/project.md --
---
type: Project
id: empty-project
title: Empty project
---
# Empty project
## Goals
No current delivery goals.
## Current commitments
None
## Open decisions
None
-- original.md --
---
type: Project
id: empty-project
title: Empty project
---
